evidence.quote: All subjects are taught in English.
The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries Switzerland United Kingdom 500 EUR
Additionally, the international students from non-EU/EEA countries are required to pay the application fee of 60 EUR.
University entrance qualification Copy of your identity card Curriculum vitae Proof of language proficiency, if applicable Certificate of exmatriculation, if you have already studied

notes: The tuition fee of 500 EUR per semester is stated only for applicants from non-EU countries (including Switzerland and the United Kingdom) and is shown on the DAAD page; the official programme page says 'No tuition fees, only student union fee', which appears to apply to EU/EEA students. Additionally, non-EU/EEA students must pay a one-time 60 EUR application fee and a 500 EUR service fee per semester to DIT; these are institution-wide fees, not tuition. The application deadline 15 April - 15 July is given as a recurring yearly window, and the extraction assumed the year 2027 based on the DAAD database overview '2026/2027'; the pages do not state a specific year. The application channel is the DIT's own portal Primuss; the pages do not mention uni-assist for this programme. Documents listed here are for bachelor applicants in general; the complete list is generated in the Primuss portal.

evidence.quote: B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: TOEFL iBT (before 2026): 72 TOEIC Reading: 385 Listening: 400 IELTS Academic: 5.5 telc English: telc English B2 PTE Academic: 59
